$comment: Prompt manifest for the sculpted animal bodies. Like props.json, this file is the source and the
.glb files it produces are cached in assets/meshy/animals/ and committed: Meshy is not
deterministic, and every file cost credits that a rebuild must not spend again.
Each mesh is rigged onto its animal's own body-plan skeleton by tools/blender/characters.py
(SOURCE_MESHES), so the pose asked for here is what the rig is fitted to: legs straight and
apart, arms held clear of the body, tail out behind. A pose with a paw against the chest or a
tail wrapped round the legs cannot be skinned to separate bones, whatever it looks like.
Preview mode only — geometry, no texture. Colour comes from the animal's palette at build time.
The kangaroo was generated before this manifest existed; its prompt is in provenance.json.
style: full body, single animal, anatomically plausible proportions, clean game-ready model, one smooth closed surface, no base, no ground plane, no pedestal
negative: multiple animals, baby, cub, base, pedestal, ground plane, text, watermark, chibi, oversized head, clothing, armor, accessories, saddle, weapon, wings
